description: The file contains source code implementing various tensor distribution operations optimized for Apple's Metal Performance Shaders (MPS) backend within the PyTorch framework. It includes implementations for random number generation, distribution sampling (normal, Bernoulli, uniform, exponential, multinomial), and related utilities, leveraging MPSGraph API and custom caching mechanisms.

classes.name: RandomCachedGraph
classes.description: A cache structure for MPS random graph operations, holding tensors for probabilities, results, states, means, and standard deviations relevant for various distributions.

methods.name: random_mps_impl
methods.description: Template function implementing tensor random generation on MPS for Uniform and Normal distributions, managing cache and distribution specifics.

methods.name: normal_mps_impl
methods.description: Implements normal distribution sampling for tensors on MPS with optional mean and std tensors.

methods.name: bernoulli_mps_impl
methods.description: Implements Bernoulli distribution sampling for tensors on MPS based on probability tensors.
